summary: Completed API and responsive UI smoke/regression testing for Nest Services. All requested public APIs and the main mobile flows passed.

integration_issues.issue: Booking form date, time, and name fields are not used; App.book() always POSTs hardcoded 2026-04-05, 10:00 AM, and Arjun Sharma values.

issues: Selecting files only displays a count; no local image preview, delete, reorder, or cover selection is implemented despite the requested multi-image preview workflow.

action_items: Wire tour form state into POST /api/bookings and validate required fields before confirmation.
Add local image thumbnails and basic selection management to the admin upload flow, or explicitly scope this as a count-only MVP placeholder.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js contains the requested lightweight MVP but booking silently discards user-entered values and swallows API errors before showing success; this can report success when persistence fails.
Demo login, payment, map view, lease/maintenance actions, and WhatsApp are MOCKED/UI-only as stated in the request.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed booking, maintenance request, and contact record through public API tests; no listing seed data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview tested at https://nest-property-hub-2.preview.emergentagent.com on mobile viewport 390x844. Homepage, explore/search, wishlist, property modal/tour confirmation, portal payment/tab, admin file selection, WhatsApp presence passed. No horizontal overflow or page error elements observed.
test_credentials: No credentials required; test_credentials.md contains no credentials.
rca of the issue: Tour data loss is caused by App.book(p) constructing a fixed payload instead of receiving state from Detail; Detail only calls onBook(p), so the three form controls have no state bindings. Admin preview gap is caused by Admin storing only File objects and rendering files.length, with no URL.createObjectURL preview list.
